name: Dread Lens
summary: Screenshot-focused Fabric pack: Hysteria + Insanity horror shaders at full quality, with every performance mod that doesn't touch visuals.

mods.why: Library required by most mods
Shader loader (runs Hysteria / Insanity on top of Sodium). Listed first so its newest stable release decides the Sodium version
Rendering engine rewrite - the biggest FPS win
Game logic / tick optimisation, no visual changes
Cuts RAM usage
Faster launch, lower memory, many bug fixes
Faster immediate-mode rendering (GUI, text, entities)
Skips rendering entities/block entities you cannot see
Throttles FPS when the window is unfocused / minimised
Micro-optimisations for lightmap, sky and entity data
Extra Sodium toggles (fog, particles, animations)
Cleaner video settings UI
In-game mod config menu
Huge view distance via LODs - Hysteria supports it natively
Connected textures (glass, bookshelves...) for nicer shots
Pre-generate the area you want to shoot so it's fully loaded
Detach the camera to frame shots anywhere
Smooth zoom for telephoto framing
Render screenshots at custom resolutions (4K/8K) independent of window size
Record & replay with a free camera - perfect for cinematic stills

shaders.why: Default shader - atmospheric horror, based on Photon, Distant Horizons support
The original horror shader (BSL-based), Hysteria's predecessor
